# Query planner, explain plans and covered queries — vocabulary

> Terms of this concept, one per line: canonical name, relation to Query planner, explain plans and covered queries, definition where a source gives one, and the words people use instead (`aka:`). Read before the index when a term is unfamiliar.

## Terms

- **index** · self — Index prefixes are the beginning subsets of indexed fields. Compound indexes support queries on all fields included in the index prefix. · aka: indexes, indices, indexing, indexed — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-compound/#index-prefixes
- **compound index** · hyponym — Index prefixes are the beginning subsets of indexed fields. Compound indexes support queries on all fields included in the index prefix. · aka: compound indexes, composite index, composite indexes, multi-column index, multicolumn index · MongoDB 'compound' = SQL 'composite'/'multicolumn' — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-compound/#index-prefixes
- **unique index** · hyponym · aka: unique indexes, uniqueIndex
- **partial index** · hyponym · aka: partial indexes, filtered index, partialIndexes
- **B-tree** · hyponym · aka: btree, B+tree, b-tree index, B-tree indexes
- **GIN index** · hyponym · aka: GIN, GIN indexes, generalized inverted index, gin_trgm_ops · Postgres
- **GiST index** · hyponym · aka: GiST, SP-GiST, GiST indexes, btree_gist · Postgres
- **BRIN index** · hyponym · aka: BRIN, block range index, BRIN indexes · Postgres
- **hashed index** · hyponym · aka: hashed indexes, hash index, hash indexes, $toHashedIndexKey
- **text index** · hyponym · aka: text indexes, full-text index, search index, search indexes, withSearchIndex, tsvector, pg_trgm · full-text/search indexes (Atlas Search, Convex search index, Postgres FTS)
- **vector index** · hyponym · aka: vector indexes, HNSW, IVFFlat, DiskANN, vectorIndex, approximate nearest neighbor · pgvector / Atlas Vector Search / Convex vector index — an index type, not the Pinecone sense
- **multikey index** · hyponym · aka: multikey, multikey indexes
- **TTL index** · hyponym · aka: TTL indexes, expireAfterSeconds
- **wildcard index** · hyponym · aka: wildcard indexes
- **geospatial index** · hyponym · aka: geospatial indexes, 2dsphere, 2d index
- **clustered index** · hyponym · aka: clustered indexes, clustered collection, WITHOUT ROWID
- **expression index** · hyponym · aka: expression indexes, functional index, index on an expression
- **sparse index** · hyponym · aka: sparse indexes
- **hidden index** · hyponym — Hidden indexes are not visible to the [query planner](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans/) and cannot be used to support a query. · aka: hidden indexes, hideIndex, unhideIndex — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden/#chunk-0
- **index definition** · part · aka: index name, index fields, index key, index keys, key pattern, index entry, index entries, index bounds, index specification, IndexFields, IndexName
- **index prefix** · part — Index prefixes are the beginning subsets of indexed fields. Compound indexes support queries on all fields included in the index prefix. · aka: index prefixes, leftmost prefix, left-most prefix, prefix of the index, leading column — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-compound/#index-prefixes
- **covered query** · dependent · aka: covered queries, covering index, covering indexes, index-only scan, index only scan, covered by an index, cover multiple queries
- **ESR rule** · dependent · aka: ESR guideline, ESR, equality sort range, Equality, Sort, Range
- **index build** · dependent · aka: index builds, CREATE INDEX, createIndex, createIndexes, DROP INDEX, dropIndex, dropIndexes, CONCURRENTLY, index creation, create an index, add an index, drop an index, rolling index build, staged index, getIndexes, listIndexes, index backfill
- **@@index** · instance · aka: @@unique · Prisma schema index attributes
- **withIndex** · instance · aka: IndexRangeBuilder, index range, range expression, .index(, IndexRange, LowerBoundIndexRangeBuilder · Convex index API
- **selectivity** · measure — Selectivity is a query property that describes the ratio of documents matching the query versus the total number of documents in a collection. The selectivity of an index describes how many documents a unique index key matches. A query or index has high selectivity when proportionally few documents  · aka: selective, cardinality, high-cardinality, planner statistics, sqlite_stat1, n_distinct, pg_stats — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/create-queries-that-ensure-selectivity/#chunk-0
- **totalKeysExamined** · measure · aka: totalDocsExamined, keysExamined, docsExamined, nReturned, executionStats, executionTimeMillis
- **query planner** · whole — Hidden indexes are not visible to the [query planner](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans/) and cannot be used to support a query. · aka: query optimizer, planner, optimizer, winningPlan, rejectedPlans, plan cache — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/index-hidden/#chunk-0
- **explain plan** · related · aka: explain(), EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, query plan, execution plan, explain output, explain results, explain("executionStats"), explain plans
- **index hint** · related · aka: hint(), cursor.hint, $hint, FORCE INDEX, USE INDEX, IGNORE INDEX
- **IXSCAN** · abbreviation · aka: index scan, index scans, Index Only Scan, Bitmap Index Scan, DISTINCT_SCAN, USING INDEX, USING COVERING INDEX
- **collection scan** · contrast · aka: collection scans, COLLSCAN, full table scan, full table scans, table scan, table scans, sequential scan, seq scan, full scan, SCAN TABLE, scans the entire collection, scans every document
- **unused index** · problem · aka: unused indexes, redundant index, redundant indexes, duplicate index, index usage, $indexStats, indexStats
- **index overhead** · problem · aka: too many indexes, index maintenance, write overhead, index size, write amplification, index bloat, bloated index, index bloating, REINDEX, reIndex
- **blocking sort** · problem · aka: blocking sorts, in-memory sort, sort in memory, SORT_KEY_GENERATOR, allowDiskUse, memory limit for sort
- **slow query** · related · aka: slow queries, Performance Advisor, index suggestion, index suggestions
- **query optimization** · hypernym · aka: optimize queries, query tuning
- **unique constraint** · near-synonym · aka: unique constraints, UNIQUE( · backed by a unique index in every engine here
